يستقدروا (form X)
# يَسْتَقْدِرُوا (yastaqdirū) /jas.taq.di.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْدَرَ (istaqdara)
# يُسْتَقْدَرُوا (yustaqdarū) /jus.taq.da.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْدَرَ (istaqdara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
